integrity: An analytic theorem with self-contained argument and a finite numerical cross-check; mathematical priority not independently certified. An original 1989 report was identified but not fully retrieved.
scientific_limitations: Two independent identically distributed Poisson counts only; no conclusion for larger samples, heterogeneous means or other parent laws. Established strict global Fano comparison is not a general stochastic order.
title: A strict dispersion ordering of the two Poisson extremes
